_notes.summary: Personal milestones are per-member campaign goals that persist for the full campaign (not per-beat). Completing a milestone grants a flat prestige bonus tracked separately from beat prestige.
_notes.availability: Universal milestones are available to every enlisted member. Chapter-affinity milestones are available if the member's chapter has a tag_weight >= 1 for that tag. A member may have up to 13 chapter-affinity milestone sets active depending on their chapter.
_notes.tracking: All milestones are count-based. auto_track: true means the bot can derive the count from campaign_log + beat_record data automatically. auto_track: false means the member self-reports via /milestone-claim with a screenshot URL. Bot logs claim with submitted_by + timestamp for WM review.
_notes.completion: Once threshold is reached, bot posts announcement and adds prestige_reward to the member's prestige total. Milestone cannot be repeated — it completes once and stays completed.
_notes.milestone_ids: Unique per section. Universal: u_01–u_08. Chapter-affinity prefixed by tag: term_01, agg_01, etc.

universal.label: Geneseed Bearer
universal.description: Carry geneseed to extraction in a qualifying op.
universal.claim_note: Self-report via /milestone-claim with screenshot of geneseed pickup or extraction screen.

universal.label: Armory Adept
universal.description: Recover armory data in a qualifying op.
universal.claim_note: Self-report. Screenshot of armory data interaction or post-op summary.

universal.label: Terminus Witness
universal.description: Participate in an op where a confirmed terminus target was killed (campaign_log terminus_killed field set).
universal.claim_note: Bot derives from campaign_log terminus_killed entries submitted by this member.

universal.label: Apex Slayer
universal.description: Kill a named boss creature during an op — e.g. Trygon on Exfiltration, Hierophant on Termination, Lictor Prime on Purgation.
universal.claim_note: Self-report. Screenshot of kill or post-op summary showing boss death.

universal.label: Sgt Bonded
universal.description: Complete ops in a squad led by a Watch Sergeant (Sgt must be in the same session and listed in the run).
universal.claim_note: Self-report. Sgt must confirm via reaction or co-submission.

universal.label: Campaign Veteran
universal.description: Complete qualifying ops during the campaign window (any difficulty, any mission).
universal.claim_note: Bot derives from campaign_log entries submitted by this member for this campaign.

universal.label: Mission Specialist
universal.description: Complete the same mission five times. Any mission ID — but must be the same one throughout.
universal.claim_note: Bot derives from campaign_log. Member declares mission ID when claiming.

universal.label: Full Extraction
universal.description: Complete an op where every squad member extracted alive — no one left incapacitated at the LZ.
universal.claim_note: Self-report. Screenshot of extraction screen showing full squad alive.
